# API and card contract (v1, 2026-11-23)

Single source for the frontend (T6) and backend (T2/T3/T5). Change it only through the coordinator. Examples live in
`contract/fixtures/`; both sides' tests load them. Numbers in fixtures are **illustrative** (computed with a quick
script, not by the production core) — correctness is tested in the backend, not by these files.

## Conventions
- Same origin, JSON, paths under `/api`. Session cookie `oa_session` (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, `Secure` by env).
- Times: ISO 8601 UTC strings. IDs: opaque strings with a type prefix (`u_`, `c_`, `m_`, `q_`, `t_`).
- **The frontend never formats or computes numbers.** Every number shown comes from a `*_display` field.
  High-precision values (`distance`, `price`, decimal strings) are only shown in the trace view.
- Errors: HTTP status + `{"error": {"code": "<snake_case>", "message": "<human text>"}}`.
  Common codes: `unauthorized` (401), `not_found` (404; also for other users' objects), `bad_request` (400),
  `rate_limited` (429), `llm_unavailable` (503).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/health` | – | `{"status":"ok","network_fingerprint":"sha256:…"}` |
| GET | `/api/config` | – | `{"dev_login":true,"google_client_id":null}` |
| POST | `/api/auth/dev` | `{"username","password"}` | `User` + sets cookie; 401 `invalid_credentials` |
| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | – | `{"ok":true}` |
| GET | `/api/me` | – | `User` or 401 |
| GET | `/api/conversations` | – | `{"conversations":[ConversationSummary]}` newest first |
| POST | `/api/conversations` | `{}` | `ConversationSummary` |
| GET | `/api/conversations/{id}` | – | `Conversation` (messages oldest first; card states are current server state) |
| POST | `/api/conversations/{id}/messages` | `{"text"}` | **SSE stream** (below) |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{id}/book` | `{"nonce"}` | `{"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}` or error (below) |
| GET | `/api/quotes/{id}/trace` | – | `Trace` |
| GET | `/api/tickets` | – | `{"tickets":[TicketCard]}` newest first |
| GET | `/api/debug/sse-ping` | – | SSE: `ping` with `{"seq":n}` immediately, then every 2 s, 5 events total |

Booking errors: `invalid_nonce` (409), `not_presented` (409), `expired` (409), `already_booked` (409),
`stale` (409; data changed — ask for a new quote), `not_found` (404), `conversation_busy` (409; a reply is still
being generated — retry after `done`), `data_unavailable` (503; route data could not be read — retry; the quote and
nonce are unchanged).

## Objects

```ts
type User = { id: string; display_name: string; auth_provider: "dev" | "google" }
type ConversationSummary = { id: string; title: string; created_at: string; updated_at: string; preview: string }
type Conversation = ConversationSummary & { messages: Message[] }
type Message = {
  id: string; role: "user" | "assistant" | "system"   // system = booking results etc.
  text: string                                        // markdown for assistant; plain for user
  cards: Card[]; created_at: string
}
type Leg = { from: string; to: string; distance_display: string; distance: string }
type CardState = { status: "quoted" | "presented" | "booked" | "expired" | "stale";
                   bookable: boolean; nonce: string | null; ticket_id: string | null }

type Card = QuoteCard | BookingRequestCard | TicketCard | TicketListCard | NoServiceCard
          | AmbiguousCityCard | UnknownCityCard | NoticeCard

type QuoteCard = { type: "quote"; id: string /* q_ */; origin: string; destination: string
  legs: Leg[]; transfers: string[]; distance_display: string; price_display: string
  distance: string; price: string; expires_at: string; state: CardState }
type BookingRequestCard = Omit<QuoteCard, "type"> & { type: "booking_request" }   // id is the quote id
type TicketCard = { type: "ticket"; id: string /* t_ */; quote_id: string; origin: string; destination: string
  legs: Leg[]; transfers: string[]; distance_display: string; price_display: string; booked_at: string }
type TicketListCard = { type: "ticket_list"; count: number; filter: Record<string, string>; tickets: TicketCard[] }
type NoServiceCard = { type: "no_service"; city: string
  nearest: { city: string; distance_display: string }[] }          // up to 3, nearest first
type AmbiguousCityCard = { type: "ambiguous_city"; query: string
  candidates: { city: string; is_hub: boolean; connected_hubs: string[] }[] }
type UnknownCityCard = { type: "unknown_city"; query: string; suggestions: string[] }
type NoticeCard = { type: "notice"; code: "same_city" | "unreachable" | "quote_expired" | "stale"; message: string }

type Trace = { quote_id: string; formula: string; algorithm: string; network_fingerprint: string
  legs: (Leg & { from_coord: [number, number]; to_coord: [number, number]; source: string })[]
  distance: string; price: string; distance_display: string; price_display: string; note: string }
```

Card buttons: a quote or booking-request card shows **Confirm booking** only when `state.bookable` is true; clicking
posts `{"nonce": state.nonce}` to `/api/quotes/{id}/book`. While a stream is running, buttons stay disabled until
`done`; after `done` (or on reload) the card state from the server wins.

## SSE stream (`POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages`)

`Content-Type: text/event-stream`. Each event: `event: <name>\ndata: <json>\n\n`.

| event | data | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `user_message` | `Message` | the stored user message, first event |
| `status` | `{"text":"Looking up routes…"}` | progress, replaceable |
| `card` | `{"card": Card}` | push immediately; state.bookable is false until `done` |
| `delta` | `{"text":"…"}` | append; already validated text (one sentence or more) |
| `replace` | `{"text":"…"}` | replace the whole assistant text so far |
| `ping` | `{}` | heartbeat every 15 s; ignore |
| `done` | `{"message": Message}` | final assistant message incl. cards with current states |
| `error` | `{"code","message"}` | stream ends; the user message is kept |

Example: `contract/fixtures/sse_quote_turn.txt`.
# Implementation — 03-slice T2 store + airline (issue #1)

> round 02 的改动见文末 §6；§1–§5 中与之冲突的地方已就地更新。

- Source state: `it03-airline` @ `6a19410`（被测提交；其后只有文档提交）
- 环境：macOS，uv，Python 3.12.8；**无新增依赖**（stdlib `sqlite3` / `hmac` / `threading` / `asyncio`）
- 范围：`backend/app/store/**`、`backend/app/airline/**`、对应测试；没有改 core、契约、`main.py`、`conftest.py`

## 1. 做了什么

### store（`backend/app/store/`）
- `db.py`：`Store(path, clock=utc_now)`。每次操作开一个连接（线程间可共享 `Store`）；`Store.write()` 是一个
  `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务（正常退出提交，任何异常回滚），`Store.read()` 是一个只读快照。WAL、`foreign_keys=ON`。
  schema 版本用 `PRAGMA user_version`（当前 1），重复打开不重复迁移，版本比代码新则拒绝启动。
  时间一律 ISO 8601 UTC 到秒（`iso()` 向下取整，拒绝无时区的 datetime）；id 为 `前缀_16 位 hex`。
- `records.py`：接收连接的行级函数（可在一个事务里组合）；`Store` 上有同名的单事务包装
  （`upsert_user`、`create_conversation`、`get_conversation`（带归属）、`list_conversations`（含 `preview`）、
  `set_conversation_title`、`add_message`、`list_messages`、`add_llm_call`、`add_tool_call`、`list_*`）。
- 表：design §7 的 7 张表，外加：
  - `messages.seq`、`llm_calls.seq`、`tool_calls.seq`（自增，保证同一秒内的顺序）；`llm_calls.created_at`、
    `tool_calls.created_at`；
  - `quotes` 增加 `origin`、`destination`、`status_reason`、`created_at`、`presented_at`、`closed_at`；`legs` 的每段含
    `from / to / distance / from_coord / to_coord / source`（坐标按库里原文存成字符串）；
  - `tickets` 增加 `origin`、`destination`、`confirmed_message_id`（点的是哪条消息里的卡）；
    `tickets.network_fingerprint` 是**出票复核时**的库指纹，`quotes.network_fingerprint` 是报价时的；
  - **`quote_cards(quote_id, message_id, presented_at, nonce_used_at)` 取代 `quotes.nonce_hash`**（见 §3 决定 1）。
- 库层兜底（应用代码写错也过不去）：`tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`（B5）；触发器「只能给 `presented` 的 quote 写票」
  （B2/B7）、「`booked / expired / stale` 不能再变」（Q3）、「票不可修改」；`status`、`role` 有 CHECK。

### airline（`backend/app/airline/`）
- `service.py`：`Airline(store, networks, *, locks=None, nonce_secret=None, quote_ttl=15min)`，时钟取 `store.clock`。
  - 工具（聊天轮次内调用，返回 `Result(code, data, cards)`）：`find_city`、`quote_route`、`request_booking`、
    `list_tickets`。`data` 只有名字、id 和显示值，给 LLM 用；`cards` 是契约里的卡片对象。
  - `post_assistant_message(...)`：`done` 时刻。一个事务里存 assistant 消息并把其中的 quote / booking_request 卡
    `quoted → presented`，登记 `quote_cards`，返回带 `state.nonce` 的契约 `Message`。
  - `book(user_id, quote_id, nonce)`：唯一的出票入口；`trace`、`tickets`、`messages`、`get_quote` 为读接口。
- `cards.py`：8 种卡片 + `CardState` + `Trace` 的构造函数，只从存档记录渲染；显示值只经 `core.pricing.fmt_km / fmt_usd`。
- `locks.py`：`ConversationLocks`（每会话一把锁，同步 `hold()` 和异步 `hold_async()` 是同一把）。

### 出票 `book` 的检查顺序（全部在会话锁 + 一个 `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务内）
| 步骤 | 规则 | 不满足时 |
|---|---|---|
| quote 存在且属于当前用户 | B1 | `not_found` 404（不区分「不存在」和「别人的」） |
| 未过 15 分钟（`now >= expires_at` 即过期；`created_at` 取整到秒，所以实际年龄不会超过 15 分钟） | B4 | quote → `expired`，`expired` 409 |
| 状态 | B5 / Q3 / B2 | `booked` → `already_booked`（带已有票 id）；`expired` / `stale` → 同名错误；`quoted` → `not_presented` |
| nonce 属于这张 quote 的某张已展示卡片且未用过 | B3 | `invalid_nonce` 409，无任何副作用 |
| 复核：`NetworkProvider.current(strict=True)`（必算内容哈希）→ 每个城市仍在且坐标相同 → `price_path` 重算，各段距离、总距离、价格字符串逐一相等 → `cheapest_route` 仍是同一城市序列和价格 | B6 | 读到且不一致：quote → `stale`（原因写入 `status_reason`），`stale` 409；**库读不到 / 不合法 / WAL 模式：`data_unavailable` 503，不改 quote、不消耗 nonce，同一次点击可重试** |
| 写票 → quote → `booked` → 追加 system 消息「Ticket booked.」+ 票卡 | B5 / B7 | 任何异常整体回滚（nonce 也不消耗） |

拒绝且改了状态（expired / stale）时，先 COMMIT 再抛 `BookingError`。

## 2. 给 T3（agent）/ T5（API）的接口

```python
from app.store import Store
from app.airline import Airline, BookingError, ConversationBusy, ConversationLocks, NotFound, Result
from app.core.network import NetworkProvider

store = Store("data/app.db")                       # 时钟可注入：Store(path, clock=fake)
airline = Airline(store, NetworkProvider(db_path), nonce_secret=os.environ.get("NONCE_SECRET", "").encode() or None)
```

**T3（一轮对话）**
```python
async with airline.locks.hold_async(conversation_id):          # 整轮持有；同步代码用 with airline.locks.hold(...)
    user_msg = store.add_message(user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
    r = airline.quote_route(user_id, conversation_id, origin, destination)   # Result
    r = airline.request_booking(user_id, conversation_id, quote_id)          # Result，永不出票
    r = airline.find_city(name); r = airline.list_tickets(user_id, city=..., booked_after=...)
    #   r.code: "ok" 或错误码；r.data → 给 LLM（无 nonce）；r.cards → 立即发 SSE `card`（state.bookable 恒为 false）
    store.add_tool_call(user_id, user_msg["id"], name, args, result, latency_ms=...)
    message = airline.post_assistant_message(user_id, conversation_id, text, cards, guard_problems)
    #   → 契约 Message，quote 卡此时才有 nonce；原样放进 SSE `done`
```
- 工具自己**不拿锁**，调用方（轮次）持锁。锁不可重入。
- `Result.code`：`find_city`：`ok / unknown_city / ambiguous_city / no_service`；`quote_route`：再加
  `same_city / unreachable`；`request_booking`：`ok / not_found / quote_expired / stale / already_booked`（带票卡）；
  `list_tickets`：`ok / bad_request`（时间解析不了）。
- `quote_route`、`post_assistant_message`、`messages` 对不属于该用户的会话抛 `NotFound`；`locations.db` 不合法时
  `find_city / quote_route` 抛 `core.network.NetworkDataError`（T3 当作工具失败处理）。
- **nonce 不能进 LLM 上下文**：`Result` 里永远没有 nonce；发给 LLM 的历史请用 `Result.data`，不要用
  `post_assistant_message` / `messages` 返回的卡片。
- quote / booking_request 卡在消息里只存引用 `{"type","id"}`，每次读取时从 quote 行重新渲染（改不了价格）。

**T5（HTTP）**
```python
try:
    out = airline.book(user_id, quote_id, body["nonce"])        # {"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}
except BookingError as e:
    return JSONResponse(e.as_response(), status_code=e.status)  # 契约错误体；e.ticket_id（already_booked）
airline.trace(user_id, quote_id)        # Trace；NotFound → 404
airline.tickets(user_id)                # [TicketCard]，新的在前
airline.messages(user_id, conv_id)      # [Message]，卡片状态 = 服务端当前状态（含可用的 nonce）；NotFound → 404
store.get_conversation(user_id, conv_id) / store.list_conversations(user_id) / store.create_conversation(user_id)
```
- `book` **自己拿会话锁**，调用时不要已经持有该锁；它是阻塞调用，放在同步路由（线程池）里；`async def` 路由用
  `await airline.book_async(...)`。等锁默认最多 5 s（`lock_timeout`），超时抛 `BookingError("conversation_busy")` 409。
- `Store` 上所有收会话 id / 消息 id 的方法第一个参数都是 `user_id`，同一事务里查归属，不是自己的抛 `NotFound`
  （`app.store.NotFound`，与 `app.airline.NotFound` 是同一个类）。
- `Conversation` = `store.get_conversation(...)` + `{"messages": airline.messages(...)}`。
- 单进程内共用**同一个** `Airline`（或同一个 `ConversationLocks`）实例，聊天和出票才是同一把锁。

## 3. 需要协调者知道的决定

1. **nonce 是派生的，不入库**：`nonce = "n_" + HMAC-SHA256(secret, quote_id ␟ user_id ␟ message_id)[:32]`，
   与设计「绑定 quote、用户、卡片所在消息」一致。库里只记「哪条消息展示过哪张 quote 的卡」和是否已用
   （`quote_cards`），所以 §7 的 `quotes.nonce_hash` 没有采用。原因：契约要求重新加载会话后卡片仍带可用的 nonce
   （Q2），只存哈希做不到，存明文又不如不存。`nonce_secret` 默认每进程随机：重启后旧页面上的 nonce 失效
   （`invalid_nonce`），刷新即可拿到新的；想跨重启保持，T5 / T7 传入环境变量。**design §7 需要协调者同步。**
2. **nonce 在 `done` 时签发，不在 `request_booking` 时**：契约规定 `card` 事件里 `bookable=false`，`done` 之后才可点。
   `request_booking` 只校验并返回确认卡；这样工具结果里从来没有 nonce。
3. 一张 quote 可以有多张卡（行程卡、确认卡、不同消息），各有自己的 nonce，任意一张可点，票只有一张。
4. `request_booking` 只接受**本会话**的 quote（别的会话的返回 `not_found`）。
5. 复核通过但库文件变过（无关行、同内容替换文件）照常出票；复核要求「仍是最便宜且**同一条**路线」，
   出现等价平手导致规范路线变了也算 `stale`。
6. 复核和提交之间库文件再变的窗口（毫秒级）无法在 SQLite 事务里消除，按「点击时刻的库」处理。
7. 契约 fixture 与真实库的两处出入（fixture 本来就标注为示意，未改契约）：`trace.json` 最后一段 source 写的是
   `locations.connected_hubs(Lima)`，真实库里 Lima 是 hub，实际为 `hub_links(Amsterdam, Lima)`；`"San Jose"`
   精确命中库内城市（core 行为），不产生歧义卡，折叠后才歧义（如 `"san jose"`）。`similar_names` 只在
   `Result.data` 里，契约的 QuoteCard 没有对应字段。
8. `Trace.formula / algorithm` 直接用 core 的常量（文字与 fixture 的示意文字不同，形状一致）。

错误体的键集合和叶子类型，产出的对象必须键完全一致、类型在示例出现过（校验器自身有反例测试）。

| GET | `/api/conversations` | – | `{"conversations":[ConversationSummary]}` newest first |
| POST | `/api/conversations` | `{}` | `ConversationSummary` |
| GET | `/api/conversations/{id}` | – | `Conversation` (messages oldest first; card states are current server state) |
| POST | `/api/conversations/{id}/messages` | `{"text"}` | **SSE stream** (below) |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{id}/book` | `{"nonce"}` | `{"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}` or error (below) |
| GET | `/api/quotes/{id}/trace` | – | `Trace` |
| GET | `/api/tickets` | – | `{"tickets":[TicketCard]}` newest first |
| GET | `/api/debug/sse-ping` | – | SSE: `ping` with `{"seq":n}` immediately, then every 2 s, 5 events total |

Booking errors: `invalid_nonce` (409), `not_presented` (409), `expired` (409), `already_booked` (409),
`stale` (409; data changed — ask for a new quote), `not_found` (404), `conversation_busy` (409; a reply is still
being generated — retry after `done`), `data_unavailable` (503; route data could not be read — retry; the quote and
nonce are unchanged).

## Objects

```ts
type User = { id: string; display_name: string; auth_provider: "dev" | "google" }
type ConversationSummary = { id: string; title: string; created_at: string; updated_at: string; preview: string }
type Conversation = ConversationSummary & { messages: Message[] }
type Message = {
  id: string; role: "user" | "assistant" | "system"   // system = booking results etc.
  text: string                                        // markdown for assistant; plain for user
  cards: Card[]; created_at: string
}
type Leg = { from: string; to: string; distance_display: string; distance: string }
type CardState = { status: "quoted" | "presented" | "booked" | "expired" | "stale";
                   bookable: boolean; nonce: string | null; ticket_id: string | null }

type Card = QuoteCard | BookingRequestCard | TicketCard | TicketListCard | NoServiceCard
          | AmbiguousCityCard | UnknownCityCard | NoticeCard

type QuoteCard = { type: "quote"; id: string /* q_ */; origin: string; destination: string
  legs: Leg[]; transfers: string[]; distance_display: string; price_display: string
  distance: string; price: string; expires_at: string; state: CardState }
type BookingRequestCard = Omit<QuoteCard, "type"> & { type: "booking_request" }   // id is the quote id
type TicketCard = { type: "ticket"; id: string /* t_ */; quote_id: string; origin: string; destination: string
  legs: Leg[]; transfers: string[]; distance_display: string; price_display: string; booked_at: string }
type TicketListCard = { type: "ticket_list"; count: number; filter: Record<string, string>; tickets: TicketCard[] }
type NoServiceCard = { type: "no_service"; city: string
  nearest: { city: string; distance_display: string }[] }          // up to 3, nearest first
type AmbiguousCityCard = { type: "ambiguous_city"; query: string
  candidates: { city: string; is_hub: boolean; connected_hubs: string[] }[] }
```

  `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务（正常退出提交，任何异常回滚），`Store.read()` 是一个只读快照。WAL、`foreign_keys=ON`。
  schema 版本用 `PRAGMA user_version`（当前 1），重复打开不重复迁移，版本比代码新则拒绝启动。
  时间一律 ISO 8601 UTC 到秒（`iso()` 向下取整，拒绝无时区的 datetime）；id 为 `前缀_16 位 hex`。
- `records.py`：接收连接的行级函数（可在一个事务里组合）；`Store` 上有同名的单事务包装
  （`upsert_user`、`create_conversation`、`get_conversation`（带归属）、`list_conversations`（含 `preview`）、
  `set_conversation_title`、`add_message`、`list_messages`、`add_llm_call`、`add_tool_call`、`list_*`）。
- 表：design §7 的 7 张表，外加：
  - `messages.seq`、`llm_calls.seq`、`tool_calls.seq`（自增，保证同一秒内的顺序）；`llm_calls.created_at`、
    `tool_calls.created_at`；
  - `quotes` 增加 `origin`、`destination`、`status_reason`、`created_at`、`presented_at`、`closed_at`；`legs` 的每段含
    `from / to / distance / from_coord / to_coord / source`（坐标按库里原文存成字符串）；
  - `tickets` 增加 `origin`、`destination`、`confirmed_message_id`（点的是哪条消息里的卡）；
    `tickets.network_fingerprint` 是**出票复核时**的库指纹，`quotes.network_fingerprint` 是报价时的；
  - **`quote_cards(quote_id, message_id, presented_at, nonce_used_at)` 取代 `quotes.nonce_hash`**（见 §3 决定 1）。
- 库层兜底（应用代码写错也过不去）：`tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`（B5）；触发器「只能给 `presented` 的 quote 写票」
  （B2/B7）、「`booked / expired / stale` 不能再变」（Q3）、「票不可修改」；`status`、`role` 有 CHECK。

### airline（`backend/app/airline/`）
- `service.py`：`Airline(store, networks, *, locks=None, nonce_secret=None, quote_ttl=15min)`，时钟取 `store.clock`。
  - 工具（聊天轮次内调用，返回 `Result(code, data, cards)`）：`find_city`、`quote_route`、`request_booking`、
    `list_tickets`。`data` 只有名字、id 和显示值，给 LLM 用；`cards` 是契约里的卡片对象。
  - `post_assistant_message(...)`：`done` 时刻。一个事务里存 assistant 消息并把其中的 quote / booking_request 卡
    `quoted → presented`，登记 `quote_cards`，返回带 `state.nonce` 的契约 `Message`。
  - `book(user_id, quote_id, nonce)`：唯一的出票入口；`trace`、`tickets`、`messages`、`get_quote` 为读接口。
- `cards.py`：8 种卡片 + `CardState` + `Trace` 的构造函数，只从存档记录渲染；显示值只经 `core.pricing.fmt_km / fmt_usd`。
- `locks.py`：`ConversationLocks`（每会话一把锁，同步 `hold()` 和异步 `hold_async()` 是同一把）。

### 出票 `book` 的检查顺序（全部在会话锁 + 一个 `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务内）
| 步骤 | 规则 | 不满足时 |
|---|---|---|
| quote 存在且属于当前用户 | B1 | `not_found` 404（不区分「不存在」和「别人的」） |
| 未过 15 分钟（`now >= expires_at` 即过期；`created_at` 取整到秒，所以实际年龄不会超过 15 分钟） | B4 | quote → `expired`，`expired` 409 |
| 状态 | B5 / Q3 / B2 | `booked` → `already_booked`（带已有票 id）；`expired` / `stale` → 同名错误；`quoted` → `not_presented` |
| nonce 属于这张 quote 的某张已展示卡片且未用过 | B3 | `invalid_nonce` 409，无任何副作用 |
| 复核：`NetworkProvider.current(strict=True)`（必算内容哈希）→ 每个城市仍在且坐标相同 → `price_path` 重算，各段距离、总距离、价格字符串逐一相等 → `cheapest_route` 仍是同一城市序列和价格 | B6 | 读到且不一致：quote → `stale`（原因写入 `status_reason`），`stale` 409；**库读不到 / 不合法 / WAL 模式：`data_unavailable` 503，不改 quote、不消耗 nonce，同一次点击可重试** |
| 写票 → quote → `booked` → 追加 system 消息「Ticket booked.」+ 票卡 | B5 / B7 | 任何异常整体回滚（nonce 也不消耗） |

拒绝且改了状态（expired / stale）时，先 COMMIT 再抛 `BookingError`。

# Implementation — 03-slice T2 store + airline (issue #1)

> round 02 的改动见文末 §6；§1–§5 中与之冲突的地方已就地更新。

- Source state: `it03-airline` @ `6a19410`（被测提交；其后只有文档提交）

## 1. 做了什么

### store（`backend/app/store/`）
- `db.py`：`Store(path, clock=utc_now)`。每次操作开一个连接（线程间可共享 `Store`）；`Store.write()` 是一个
  `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务（正常退出提交，任何异常回滚），`Store.read()` 是一个只读快照。WAL、`foreign_keys=ON`。
  schema 版本用 `PRAGMA user_version`（当前 1），重复打开不重复迁移，版本比代码新则拒绝启动。
  时间一律 ISO 8601 UTC 到秒（`iso()` 向下取整，拒绝无时区的 datetime）；id 为 `前缀_16 位 hex`。
- `records.py`：接收连接的行级函数（可在一个事务里组合）；`Store` 上有同名的单事务包装
  （`upsert_user`、`create_conversation`、`get_conversation`（带归属）、`list_conversations`（含 `preview`）、
  `set_conversation_title`、`add_message`、`list_messages`、`add_llm_call`、`add_tool_call`、`list_*`）。
- 表：design §7 的 7 张表，外加：
  - `messages.seq`、`llm_calls.seq`、`tool_calls.seq`（自增，保证同一秒内的顺序）；`llm_calls.created_at`、
    `tool_calls.created_at`；
  - `quotes` 增加 `origin`、`destination`、`status_reason`、`created_at`、`presented_at`、`closed_at`；`legs` 的每段含
    `from / to / distance / from_coord / to_coord / source`（坐标按库里原文存成字符串）；
  - `tickets` 增加 `origin`、`destination`、`confirmed_message_id`（点的是哪条消息里的卡）；
    `tickets.network_fingerprint` 是**出票复核时**的库指纹，`quotes.network_fingerprint` 是报价时的；
  - **`quote_cards(quote_id, message_id, presented_at, nonce_used_at)` 取代 `quotes.nonce_hash`**（见 §3 决定 1）。
- 库层兜底（应用代码写错也过不去）：`tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`（B5）；触发器「只能给 `presented` 的 quote 写票」
  （B2/B7）、「`booked / expired / stale` 不能再变」（Q3）、「票不可修改」；`status`、`role` 有 CHECK。

### airline（`backend/app/airline/`）
- `service.py`：`Airline(store, networks, *, locks=None, nonce_secret=None, quote_ttl=15min)`，时钟取 `store.clock`。
  - 工具（聊天轮次内调用，返回 `Result(code, data, cards)`）：`find_city`、`quote_route`、`request_booking`、
    `list_tickets`。`data` 只有名字、id 和显示值，给 LLM 用；`cards` 是契约里的卡片对象。
  - `post_assistant_message(...)`：`done` 时刻。一个事务里存 assistant 消息并把其中的 quote / booking_request 卡
    `quoted → presented`，登记 `quote_cards`，返回带 `state.nonce` 的契约 `Message`。
  - `book(user_id, quote_id, nonce)`：唯一的出票入口；`trace`、`tickets`、`messages`、`get_quote` 为读接口。
- `cards.py`：8 种卡片 + `CardState` + `Trace` 的构造函数，只从存档记录渲染；显示值只经 `core.pricing.fmt_km / fmt_usd`。
- `locks.py`：`ConversationLocks`（每会话一把锁，同步 `hold()` 和异步 `hold_async()` 是同一把）。

### 出票 `book` 的检查顺序（全部在会话锁 + 一个 `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务内）
| 步骤 | 规则 | 不满足时 |
|---|---|---|
| quote 存在且属于当前用户 | B1 | `not_found` 404（不区分「不存在」和「别人的」） |
| 未过 15 分钟（`now >= expires_at` 即过期；`created_at` 取整到秒，所以实际年龄不会超过 15 分钟） | B4 | quote → `expired`，`expired` 409 |
| 状态 | B5 / Q3 / B2 | `booked` → `already_booked`（带已有票 id）；`expired` / `stale` → 同名错误；`quoted` → `not_presented` |
| nonce 属于这张 quote 的某张已展示卡片且未用过 | B3 | `invalid_nonce` 409，无任何副作用 |
| 复核：`NetworkProvider.current(strict=True)`（必算内容哈希）→ 每个城市仍在且坐标相同 → `price_path` 重算，各段距离、总距离、价格字符串逐一相等 → `cheapest_route` 仍是同一城市序列和价格 | B6 | 读到且不一致：quote → `stale`（原因写入 `status_reason`），`stale` 409；**库读不到 / 不合法 / WAL 模式：`data_unavailable` 503，不改 quote、不消耗 nonce，同一次点击可重试** |
| 写票 → quote → `booked` → 追加 system 消息「Ticket booked.」+ 票卡 | B5 / B7 | 任何异常整体回滚（nonce 也不消耗） |

拒绝且改了状态（expired / stale）时，先 COMMIT 再抛 `BookingError`。

```python
airline = Airline(store, NetworkProvider(db_path), nonce_secret=os.environ.get("NONCE_SECRET", "").encode() or None)
```

**T3（一轮对话）**
```python

    user_msg = store.add_message(user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
    r = airline.quote_route(user_id, conversation_id, origin, destination)   # Result
    r = airline.request_booking(user_id, conversation_id, quote_id)          # Result，永不出票

    store.add_tool_call(user_id, user_msg["id"], name, args, result, latency_ms=...)
```

- 工具自己**不拿锁**，调用方（轮次）持锁。锁不可重入。
- `Result.code`：`find_city`：`ok / unknown_city / ambiguous_city / no_service`；`quote_route`：再加
  `same_city / unreachable`；`request_booking`：`ok / not_found / quote_expired / stale / already_booked`（带票卡）；

- **nonce 不能进 LLM 上下文**：`Result` 里永远没有 nonce；发给 LLM 的历史请用 `Result.data`，不要用

```python
except BookingError as e:
```

- `book` **自己拿会话锁**，调用时不要已经持有该锁；它是阻塞调用，放在同步路由（线程池）里；`async def` 路由用

## 3. 需要协调者知道的决定

1. **nonce 是派生的，不入库**：`nonce = "n_" + HMAC-SHA256(secret, quote_id ␟ user_id ␟ message_id)[:32]`，
   与设计「绑定 quote、用户、卡片所在消息」一致。库里只记「哪条消息展示过哪张 quote 的卡」和是否已用
   （`quote_cards`），所以 §7 的 `quotes.nonce_hash` 没有采用。原因：契约要求重新加载会话后卡片仍带可用的 nonce
   （Q2），只存哈希做不到，存明文又不如不存。`nonce_secret` 默认每进程随机：重启后旧页面上的 nonce 失效
   （`invalid_nonce`），刷新即可拿到新的；想跨重启保持，T5 / T7 传入环境变量。**design §7 需要协调者同步。**
2. **nonce 在 `done` 时签发，不在 `request_booking` 时**：契约规定 `card` 事件里 `bookable=false`，`done` 之后才可点。
   `request_booking` 只校验并返回确认卡；这样工具结果里从来没有 nonce。
3. 一张 quote 可以有多张卡（行程卡、确认卡、不同消息），各有自己的 nonce，任意一张可点，票只有一张。
4. `request_booking` 只接受**本会话**的 quote（别的会话的返回 `not_found`）。
5. 复核通过但库文件变过（无关行、同内容替换文件）照常出票；复核要求「仍是最便宜且**同一条**路线」，
   出现等价平手导致规范路线变了也算 `stale`。
6. 复核和提交之间库文件再变的窗口（毫秒级）无法在 SQLite 事务里消除，按「点击时刻的库」处理。
7. 契约 fixture 与真实库的两处出入（fixture 本来就标注为示意，未改契约）：`trace.json` 最后一段 source 写的是

   `Result.data` 里，契约的 QuoteCard 没有对应字段。
8. `Trace.formula / algorithm` 直接用 core 的常量（文字与 fixture 的示意文字不同，形状一致）。

- `locations.db` 必须是回滚日志模式且没有 `-wal` 文件（WAL 中的已提交修改不会改变主文件哈希）；部署时用原子替换 （写新文件再 rename）。读不到时出票返回 `data_unavailable`（可重试），不把报价判为 stale。 - `app.db` 在 `data/` 目录，不进 git（含用户邮箱、全部对话）。 - 用户：`(auth_provider, provider_sub)` 唯一；固定账号是 `auth_provider = "dev"`。 ## 8. API | 方法 | 路径 | 用途 | |---|---|---| | POST | `/api/auth/dev` | 固定账号登录（环境变量开关；本地 / 开发） | | POST | `/api/auth/google` | 提交 Google ID token，后端核验后发会话 cookie（05） | | POST | `/api/auth/logout` | 退出 | | GET | `/api/me` | 当前用户 | | GET | `/api/config` | 前端运行时配置（如 Google client ID，避免构建时写死） | | GET | `/api/conversations` | 会话列表（要求 10） | | POST | `/api/conversations` | 新会话 | | GET | `/api/conversations/{id}` | 会话全部消息 + 卡片（卡片状态以服务端为准） | | POST | `/api/conversations/{id}/messages` | 发消息，SSE 流式返回（§4.7） | | POST | `/api/quotes/{id}/book` | 用户点击确认出票（带 nonce；B1–B7） | | GET | `/api/quotes/{id}/trace` | 计算依据 | | GET | `/api/tickets` | 我的机票（要求 9） | **所有带 id 的读写接口都检查归属**（不是自己的返回 404），不只是出票。 ### 8.1 登录 - **分两步**：开发期和本地运行用固定账号（`DEV_AUTH_USER` / `DEV_AUTH_PASSWORD`，来自 `.env`，环境变量开关）； 数据从第一天起就按多用户设计。demo 公开前（05）接入 Google 登录并走通多用户流程。 - Google 登录：前端用 Google Identity Services 拿 **ID token**（不需要 client secret，只要 `openid email profile`）； 后端用 Google JWKS 验签，检查 `aud`、`iss`、`exp`、`email_verified`，通过后发**自己的** httpOnly 会话 cookie （`Secure` 按环境开关：Caddy 后面是 http，经 Cloudflare 对外是 https）。依赖在 05 开工时选（`google-auth` 或 `PyJWT[crypto]`）并写明理由。设计文档要写清楚这个第三方登录怎么工作（take-home 非必须项第 2 条）。 - 评审：OAuth 应用必须发布为 Production（Testing 状态只有名单内用户能登录）；另给评审一个不依赖 Google 的入口 （邀请码登录，带限额）。 - Google 只接受 `http://localhost` 或 https 域名作为 JavaScript 来源；用局域网 IP 访问时只能用固定账号。 ### 8.2 限额（公开 demo 前必须有） - 每用户每日消息数上限、全站每日 token / 费用预算（按 `llm_calls.tokens` 累计），到顶后明确提示； LLM 服务商侧也设消费上限。 ### 8.3 部署与交付 ```mermaid flowchart LR User["浏览器"] -->|HTTPS| CF["Cloudflare
ocean-above.potafree.net"] CF -->|Tunnel| Proxy subgraph Compose["docker compose（homelab，将来可换 VPS）"] Proxy["proxy · Caddy
唯一对外端口（loopback）"] Web["web · Next.js :3000"] Api["api · FastAPI :8000（单 worker）"] Proxy -->|"/api/* (SSE 不缓冲)"| Api Proxy -->|"其余"| Web end Api --- Vol[("./data/app.db")] Api --- LDB[("./locations/ 目录只读挂载")] ``` - 交付物：本地 `docker compose up` 后打开 `http://localhost:3000`；demo 站点用同一份 compose（`OCEAN_PORT=18765`）。 - 评审本地运行需要一个 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM key（README 写明怎么配）；或直接用线上 demo。 - 同源：前端只请求相对路径 `/api/*`；开发时 Next.js 把 `/api` 转给本地后端。 - `locations.db` 所在**目录**只读挂载（单文件挂载在宿主机替换文件后容器看不到新文件，指纹重载会失效）。 - 前端配置运行时从 `/api/config` 取，同一个镜像可用于本地和 demo。 - 日志 stdout/stderr，json-file 轮转 10m × 3；`restart: unless-stopped`。细节见 `docs/deploy.md`。 ## 9. 前端 - 页面：登录、聊天（会话列表 + 对话 + 卡片）、我的机票、历史会话只读查看。 - shadcn/ui + Tailwind；移动端：会话列表变抽屉、卡片单列、触控目标 ≥ 44px、无横向滚动。 - Markdown 流式渲染：优先 Vercel `streamdown`，开工前核实体积，只启用需要的部分；不合适则 `react-markdown` + 按块 memo。 def ok(self) -> bool: return self.code == "ok" class BookingError(Exception): """A refused booking. `code` / `status` are the contract's booking errors.""" _TEXT = { "not_found": (404, "Quote not found."), "invalid_nonce": (409, "This confirmation is not valid. Reload the conversation and try again."), "not_presented": (409, "This quote has not been shown to you yet."), "expired": (409, cards.MESSAGES["quote_expired"]), "already_booked": (409, "This quote is already booked."), "stale": (409, cards.MESSAGES["stale"]), "conversation_busy": (409, "A reply is still being generated. Try again when it has finished."), "data_unavailable": (503, "Route data could not be read right now. Please try again."), } def __init__(self, code: str, *, ticket_id: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None): self.code = code self.status, self.message = self._TEXT[code] self.ticket_id = ticket_id # already_booked: the existing ticket self.reason = reason # internal detail (stale, data_unavailable), not for the user super().__init__(f"{code}: {self.message}") def as_response(self) -> dict: return {"error": {"code": self.code, "message": self.message}} class Airline: def __init__(self, store: Store, networks: NetworkProvider, *, locks: ConversationLocks | None = None, nonce_secret: bytes | None = None, quote_ttl: timedelta = QUOTE_TTL): """`nonce_secret`: key for the confirmation nonces. Default: random per process, which means a restart invalidates the nonces held by open pages (reloading gets working ones). Time comes from `store.clock`.""" self.store = store self.networks = networks self.locks = locks or ConversationLocks() self.quote_ttl = quote_ttl if nonce_secret is None: nonce_secret = secrets.token_bytes(32) if not isinstance(nonce_secret, bytes) or len(nonce_secret) < MIN_SECRET_BYTES: raise ValueError(f"nonce_secret must be bytes, at least {MIN_SECRET_BYTES} long") self._secret = nonce_secret def upsert_user(self, auth_provider: str, provider_sub: str, display_name: str, email: str | None = None) -> dict: from . import records with self.write() as con: return records.upsert_user(con, self.now(), auth_provider, provider_sub, display_name, email) def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> dict | None: from . import records with self.read() as con: return records.get_user(con, user_id) def create_conversation(self, user_id: str, title: str = "") -> dict: from . import records with self.write() as con: return records.create_conversation(con, self.now(), user_id, title) def get_conversation(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> dict | None: """The conversation summary, or None when it does not exist or belongs to someone else.""" from . import records with self.read() as con: return records.get_conversation(con, user_id, conversation_id) def list_conversations(self, user_id: str) -> list[dict]: from . import records with self.read() as con: return records.list_conversations(con, user_id) def set_conversation_title(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, title: str) -> bool: from . import records with self.write() as con: state = message["cards"][0]["state"] assert state["bookable"] and state["nonce"] return result.data["quote_id"], state["nonce"] # --- direct reads of app.db --- def sql(self, query, args=()): con = sqlite3.connect(self.store.path) try: return con.execute(query, args).fetchall() finally: con.close() def status(self, quote_id): return self.sql("select status from quotes where id = ?", (quote_id,))[0][0] def ticket_count(self): return self.sql("select count(*) from tickets")[0][0] # --- changes to the private locations database --- def edit_db(self, *statements): """Run SQL on the locations copy; each statement is a string or (sql, args).""" con = sqlite3.connect(self.db) try: for statement in statements: sql, args = (statement, ()) if isinstance(statement, str) else statement con.execute(sql, args) con.commit() finally: con.close() self.bump_mtime() def bump_mtime(self): """Give the file a strictly newer mtime, so change detection never depends on how fast the test runs (the same-mtime case has its own test).""" self._mtime = max(self._mtime + 1_000_000_000, self.db.stat().st_mtime_ns) os.utime(self.db, ns=(self._mtime, self._mtime)) def replace_db(self, content: bytes): """Replace the file atomically (new inode), as a deploy would.""" tmp = self.dir / "locations.db.new" tmp.write_bytes(content) os.replace(tmp, self.db) self.bump_mtime() # --- contract fixture shapes ------------------------------------------------------------------- CARD_TYPES = ("quote", "booking_request", "ticket", "ticket_list", "no_service", "ambiguous_city", "unknown_city", "notice") _FREE_FORM = {"filter"} # Record def _learn(node, value): node = node or {"types": set(), "keys": None, "items": None} if isinstance(value, dict): node["types"].add("dict") if node["keys"] is None: node["keys"] = {} for key, sub in value.items(): node["keys"][key] = _learn(node["keys"].get(key), sub) node.setdefault("keysets", set()).add(frozenset(value)) elif isinstance(value, list): node["types"].add("list") for item in value: node["items"] = _learn(node["items"], item) else: node["types"].add(type(value).__name__) return node def _walk(value): if isinstance(value, dict): yield value for sub in value.values(): yield from _walk(sub) elif isinstance(value, list): for sub in value: yield from _walk(sub) def _fixture_documents(): for path in sorted(FIXTURES.glob("*.json")): yield path.name, json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for line in (FIXTURES / "sse_quote_turn.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(): if line.startswith("data: "): yield "sse", json.loads(line[len("data: "):]) def fixture_schemas() -> dict: """name -> shape learned from every example in contract/fixtures: the eight card types plus `message`, `trace`, `booking_ok` and `error`.""" schemas: dict = {} for name, doc in _fixture_documents(): for obj in _walk(doc): if obj.get("type") in CARD_TYPES: # contract: BookingRequestCard = Omit & {type}, so both card # types learn from the examples of either name_ = "quote" if obj["type"] == "booking_request" else obj["type"] schemas[name_] = _learn(schemas.get(name_), obj) elif {"role", "text", "cards"} <= set(obj): message = {k: v for k, v in obj.items() if k != "cards"} schemas["message"] = _learn(schemas.get("message"), message) if name == "trace.json": schemas["trace"] = _learn(None, doc) elif name == "booking_ok.json": schemas["booking_ok"] = _learn(None, {k: None for k in doc}) elif name == "booking_error_stale.json": schemas["error"] = _learn(None, doc) schemas["booking_request"] = schemas["quote"] return schemas def assert_shape(node, value, path="$"): """`value` has exactly the keys of the fixture examples at every level, and every leaf has a type some example has there.""" kind = "dict" if isinstance(value, dict) else "list" if isinstance(value, list) else type(value).__name__ assert kind in node["types"], f"{path}: {kind} not in {sorted(node['types'])}" if kind == "dict": if path.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] in _FREE_FORM: assert all(isinstance(k, str) and isinstance(v, str) for k, v in value.items()), path return assert frozenset(value) in node["keysets"], f"{path}: keys {sorted(value)} not in the contract" { "conversations": [ { "id": "c_01", "title": "Guangzhou to Lima", "created_at": "2026-11-23T08:00:00Z", "updated_at": "2026-11-23T08:03:12Z", "preview": "Your ticket is booked." }, { "id": "c_00", "title": "Abu Dhabi", "created_at": "2026-11-22T10:00:00Z", "updated_at": "2026-11-22T10:01:00Z", "preview": "Abu Dhabi has no service yet." } ] }

    def book(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str, *,
             lock_timeout: float | None = BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
        """The only way a ticket is created: the user's click on a presented card.

        Returns `{"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}` (the system message appended to the
        conversation). Raises BookingError; checked in this order: not_found, conversation_busy,
        expired, already_booked, stale, not_presented, invalid_nonce, data_unavailable, stale
        (re-check). expired and stale are final for the quote; every other refusal changes
        nothing, so the same click can be repeated.

        Blocking: it takes the conversation lock itself (do not call it while holding that lock)
        and waits up to `lock_timeout` seconds for a running chat turn, then refuses with
        conversation_busy (None waits without limit). On the event loop use `book_async`.
        """
        with self.store.read() as con:
            quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
        if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:  # B1
            raise BookingError("not_found")
        try:
            with self.locks.hold(quote["conversation_id"], timeout=lock_timeout):
                with self.store.write() as con:  # B7: one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
                    outcome = self._book(con, user_id, quote_id, nonce)
        except ConversationBusy:
            raise BookingError("conversation_busy") from None
        # A refusal may have changed the quote (expired / stale), so it is raised after COMMIT.
        if isinstance(outcome, BookingError):
            raise outcome
        return outcome

    async def book_async(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str, *,
                         lock_timeout: float | None = BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
        """`book` for async callers: runs in a worker thread, so the event loop (and the chat
        turn that may hold the conversation lock) keeps running while the click waits."""
        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.book, user_id, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=lock_timeout)

    def _book(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str) -> dict | BookingError:

             lock_timeout: float | None = BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
        """The only way a ticket is created: the user's click on a presented card.

        Returns `{"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}` (the system message appended to the
        conversation). Raises BookingError; checked in this order: not_found, conversation_busy,
        expired, already_booked, stale, not_presented, invalid_nonce, data_unavailable, stale
        (re-check). expired and stale are final for the quote; every other refusal changes
        nothing, so the same click can be repeated.

        Blocking: it takes the conversation lock itself (do not call it while holding that lock)
        and waits up to `lock_timeout` seconds for a running chat turn, then refuses with
        conversation_busy (None waits without limit). On the event loop use `book_async`.
        """
        with self.store.read() as con:
            quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
        if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:  # B1
            raise BookingError("not_found")
        try:
            with self.locks.hold(quote["conversation_id"], timeout=lock_timeout):
                with self.store.write() as con:  # B7: one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
                    outcome = self._book(con, user_id, quote_id, nonce)
        except ConversationBusy:
            raise BookingError("conversation_busy") from None
        # A refusal may have changed the quote (expired / stale), so it is raised after COMMIT.
        if isinstance(outcome, BookingError):
            raise outcome
        return outcome

    async def book_async(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str, *,
                         lock_timeout: float | None = BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
        """`book` for async callers: runs in a worker thread, so the event loop (and the chat
        turn that may hold the conversation lock) keeps running while the click waits."""
        return await asyncio.to_thread(self.book, user_id, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=lock_timeout)

"""HTTP API (T5): every endpoint, auth, ownership and the contract fixtures' shapes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.api import Settings, session
from app.main import create_app

from .airline_helpers import SECRET, World, assert_card, assert_message, assert_shape, fixture_schemas

SCHEMAS = fixture_schemas()
SECRET_KEY = b"session-secret-0123456789"


@pytest.fixture
def world(tmp_path):
    return World(tmp_path / "w")


def make_settings(world, **kw):
    base = dict(app_db=world.dir / "app.db", dev_user="demo", dev_password="pw",
                session_secret=SECRET_KEY, nonce_secret=SECRET, ping_interval=0.01)
    base.update(kw)
    return Settings(**base)


@pytest.fixture
def client(world):
    with TestClient(create_app(world.db, make_settings(world), clock=world.clock)) as c:
        yield c


def as_user(client, user_id):
    client.cookies.clear()
    client.cookies.set(session.COOKIE, session.issue(SECRET_KEY, user_id, 3600))


def assert_error(res, status, code):
    assert res.status_code == status, res.text
    body = res.json()
    assert set(body) == {"error"} and set(body["error"]) == {"code", "message"}
    assert body["error"]["code"] == code and body["error"]["message"]
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS["error"], body)


# --- public endpoints -----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_health_and_config(client, world):
    res = client.get("/api/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert set(res.json()) == {"status", "network_fingerprint"} and res.json()["status"] == "ok"
    assert res.json()["network_fingerprint"].startswith("sha256:")
    assert client.get("/health").json()["status"] == "ok"  # the old path stays
    cfg = client.get("/api/config")
    assert cfg.json() == {"dev_login": True, "google_client_id": None}
    assert set(cfg.json()) == set(json.loads((world.dir.parents[1] / "contract/fixtures/config.json").read_text())) \
        if (world.dir.parents[1] / "contract/fixtures/config.json").exists() else True


def test_config_without_dev_account(world):
    with TestClient(create_app(world.db, make_settings(world, dev_user="", dev_password=""))) as c:
        assert c.get("/api/config").json()["dev_login"] is False
        assert_error(c.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "", "password": ""}), 401, "invalid_credentials")


def test_sse_ping(client):
    with client.stream("GET", "/api/debug/sse-ping") as res:
        assert res.status_code == 200
        assert res.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
        text = "".join(res.iter_text())
    events = [e for e in text.split("\n\n") if e]
    assert len(events) == 5
    for i, e in enumerate(events, 1):
        assert e == f'event: ping\ndata: {{"seq": {i}}}'


def test_sse_ping_first_event_is_immediate(world):
    settings = make_settings(world, ping_interval=30)
    with TestClient(create_app(world.db, settings)) as c:
        with c.stream("GET", "/api/debug/sse-ping") as res:
            t = time.monotonic()
            first = next(res.iter_text())
            assert time.monotonic() - t < 5 and first.startswith("event: ping")


# --- auth -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_login_me_logout(client):
    assert_error(client.get("/api/me"), 401, "unauthorized")
    assert_error(client.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "demo", "password": "bad"}), 401, "invalid_credentials")
    assert_error(client.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "x", "password": "pw"}), 401, "invalid_credentials")
    assert_error(client.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "demo"}), 400, "bad_request")
    res = client.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "demo", "password": "pw"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    user = res.json()
    assert set(user) == {"id", "display_name", "auth_provider"} and user["auth_provider"] == "dev"
    assert user["id"].startswith("u_")
    cookie = res.headers["set-cookie"].lower()
    assert "oa_session=" in cookie and "httponly" in cookie and "samesite=lax" in cookie and "secure" not in cookie
    assert client.get("/api/me").json() == user
    again = client.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "demo", "password": "pw"}).json()
    assert again["id"] == user["id"]  # same account every time
    res = client.post("/api/auth/logout")
    assert res.json() == {"ok": True}
    assert_error(client.get("/api/me"), 401, "unauthorized")


def test_cookie_secure_flag(world):
    with TestClient(create_app(world.db, make_settings(world, cookie_secure=True))) as c:
        res = c.post("/api/auth/dev", json={"username": "demo", "password": "pw"})
        assert "secure" in res.headers["set-cookie"].lower()


def test_settings_from_env():
    s = Settings.from_env({"DEV_AUTH_USER": "u", "DEV_AUTH_PASSWORD": "p", "COOKIE_SECURE": "1", "APP_DB": "/x/a.db"})
    assert (s.dev_login, s.cookie_secure, str(s.app_db)) == (True, True, "/x/a.db")
    assert Settings.from_env({}).dev_login is False and Settings.from_env({"COOKIE_SECURE": ""}).cookie_secure is False


def test_bad_cookies_are_unauthorized(client, world):
    now = time.time()
    for value in ["", "junk", "a.b.c", session.issue(b"another-secret-0123456789", world.alice, 3600),
                  session.issue(SECRET_KEY, world.alice, -10),  # expired
                  session.issue(SECRET_KEY, "u_gone", 3600)]:  # signed but no such user
        client.cookies.clear()
        client.cookies.set(session.COOKIE, value)
        assert_error(client.get("/api/me"), 401, "unauthorized")
    assert session.verify(SECRET_KEY, session.issue(SECRET_KEY, "u_1", 60, now), now) == "u_1"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("method,path,body", [
    ("get", "/api/me", None), ("get", "/api/conversations", None), ("post", "/api/conversations", {}),
    ("get", "/api/conversations/c_x", None), ("post", "/api/conversations/c_x/messages", {"text": "hi"}),
    ("post", "/api/quotes/q_x/book", {"nonce": "n"}), ("get", "/api/quotes/q_x/trace", None),
    ("get", "/api/tickets", None),
])
def test_every_protected_endpoint_needs_login(client, method, path, body):
    res = getattr(client, method)(path, **({"json": body} if body is not None else {}))
    assert_error(res, 401, "unauthorized")


# --- conversations --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_conversations_flow(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    listing = client.get("/api/conversations").json()
    assert [c["id"] for c in listing["conversations"]] == [world.conv]  # Bob's is not here

    assert client.post("/api/conversations").status_code == 200  # an empty body is fine
    assert_error(client.post("/api/conversations", content=b"[1]"), 400, "bad_request")
    assert_error(client.post("/api/conversations", content=b"{oops"), 400, "bad_request")
    ids = [c["id"] for c in client.get("/api/conversations").json()["conversations"]]
    assert ids[0] != world.conv and len(ids) == 3 and ids[-1] == world.conv  # newest first
    for c in client.get("/api/conversations").json()["conversations"]:
        assert_shape(SCHEMAS_SUMMARY, c)


def test_conversation_detail_with_cards(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    world.airline.store.add_message(world.alice, world.conv, "user", "A to D please")
    quote = world.quote("A", "D")
    world.done(quote.cards, text="Here is your route.")
    res = client.get(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    body = res.json()
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS_SUMMARY, {k: v for k, v in body.items() if k != "messages"})
    assert [m["role"] for m in body["messages"]] == ["user", "assistant"]
    for m in body["messages"]:
        assert_message(m, SCHEMAS)
    card = body["messages"][1]["cards"][0]
    assert_card(card, SCHEMAS)
    assert card["state"]["bookable"] and card["state"]["nonce"]  # the server's current state
    assert body["preview"] == "Here is your route."


def test_unknown_conversation_is_404(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    assert_error(client.get("/api/conversations/c_nope"), 404, "not_found")


# --- booking, trace, tickets ----------------------------------------------------------------
def test_book_trace_and_tickets(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    assert client.get("/api/tickets").json() == {"tickets": []}
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented("A", "D")
    trace = client.get(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/trace")
    assert trace.status_code == 200
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS["trace"], trace.json())
    assert trace.json()["quote_id"] == quote_id

    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={}), 400, "bad_request")
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": "n_wrong"}), 409, "invalid_nonce")
    res = client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": nonce})
    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
    out = res.json()
    assert set(out) == {"ticket", "message"}
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS["booking_ok"], out)
    assert_card(out["ticket"], SCHEMAS)
    assert_message(out["message"], SCHEMAS)
    assert out["message"]["role"] == "system" and out["ticket"]["quote_id"] == quote_id
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": nonce}), 409, "already_booked")

    tickets = client.get("/api/tickets").json()

    detail = client.get(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}").json()
    assert detail["messages"][-1]["id"] == out["message"]["id"]


def test_book_maps_each_error_code(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    # not_presented: quoted but never shown
    q = world.quote("A", "D").data["quote_id"]

    # stale: the data changed after the quote

    world.edit_db("DELETE FROM hub_links WHERE hub_a = 'H3' AND hub_b = 'H4'")
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": nonce}), 409, "stale")

    as_user(client, world.alice)

# Implementation — 03-slice T5 HTTP API (issue #4), part 1

- Branch `it03-api`, based on main (02-core + T2). No new dependencies. Files: `backend/app/api/{settings,session,errors,routes}.py`,
  `backend/app/main.py`, `backend/tests/test_http_api.py` (+ `test_api.py` now passes a temp `app_db`).
- Done: `/api/health` (`/health` kept), `/api/config`, `POST /api/auth/dev`, `/api/auth/logout`, `/api/me`, conversations
  (list / create / detail), `/api/quotes/{id}/book` (`airline.book_async`, `BookingError` → contract code and status),
  `/trace`, `/api/tickets`, `/api/debug/sse-ping` (first ping immediate, then every 2 s, 5 total).
- **Not done:** `POST /conversations/{id}/messages` is a stub: login and ownership are checked (404), then `501 not_implemented`.
  Waiting for T3 (`it03-agent`) to merge.

## Decisions
- **Session cookie** `oa_session`: stateless `<user_id>.<expires>.<hmac>` (HMAC-SHA256, 7 days), httpOnly, SameSite=Lax,
  `Secure` from `COOKIE_SECURE`. The user row must still exist. `SESSION_SECRET` env keeps sessions across restarts; unset →
  random per process (a restart signs everyone out). Logout clears the cookie (no server-side revocation — fine for the dev login).
- Dev login is off unless both `DEV_AUTH_USER` and `DEV_AUTH_PASSWORD` are set (`config.dev_login=false`, login → 401
  `invalid_credentials`). Constant-time compare. The user is upserted as `("dev", DEV_AUTH_USER)`.
- Settings: `APP_DB` (default `backend/data/app.db`, git-ignored), `NONCE_SECRET`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`.
  `create_app(db_path, settings, clock)` — tests pass `Settings(...)`; the Store/Airline are created in the lifespan, so
  importing `app.main` touches no file.
- One `Airline` (hence one `ConversationLocks`) per process, in `app.state.airline`; T3's chat turn must use the same one.
- Errors: every failure is `{"error":{"code","message"}}`: validation → 400 `bad_request`, unknown route 404, wrong method 405,
  `NotFound` → 404, `BookingError` → its own status, `NetworkDataError` → 503 `data_unavailable`.
- `/api/debug/sse-ping` needs no login (it is for checking the proxy does not buffer SSE).
- Sync routes run in the thread pool (store calls block); `book` and conversation creation use threads explicitly.

## Tests (`tests/test_http_api.py`, 27) — full suite 289 passed
Every endpoint; 401 for each protected endpoint and for forged / expired / unsigned-user cookies; cross-user 404 on
conversation, messages, trace and book (and Alice's quote is untouched, later bookable by Alice); each booking error code
through HTTP (`invalid_nonce`, `not_presented`, `expired`, `stale`, `already_booked`, `data_unavailable`, `conversation_busy`,
`not_found`); response key sets validated against `contract/fixtures` (`assert_shape` from T2's helpers: cards, messages, trace,
error body, summaries, me, config, tickets, booking_ok).

- **范围：** dev 登录、logout、me、config、conversations（列表、新建、详情）、book、trace、tickets、`/api/health`（`/health` 保留）、`/api/debug/sse-ping` 都做了。
- **消息接口：** `POST /conversations/{id}/messages` 先放了 501 桩，登录和归属检查已做（不是自己的会话返回 404），等 T3 合并后你给我签名再接上。
- **测试结果：** 后端全套 289 个通过，其中新增 27 个在 `backend/tests/test_http_api.py`。`tool/test_diff.sh` 无新失败，`review_lint` 通过。
- **覆盖内容：** 测试覆盖每个接口、未登录 401、伪造或过期 cookie、跨用户 404，以及出票的各个错误码。响应的键集合用 contract fixtures 校验。
- **会话 cookie：** 无状态签名 cookie，有效期 7 天，`oa_session`，httpOnly，SameSite=Lax，`COOKIE_SECURE` 控制 Secure。
- **登录不会被服务端撤销：** 退出只清除 cookie，没有服务端吊销。

create mode 100644 docs/iterations/03-slice/T3/guard_probe_results.json
 create mode 100644 docs/iterations/03-slice/T3/guard_probe_results_effort_none.json
 create mode 100644 docs/iterations/03-slice/T3/implementation.md
1:# Implementation — 03-slice T3 agent loop, tools, ReplyGuard, SSE events (issue #2)
2:
3:- Source state: `it03-agent` @ `f53dfad` 全套测试；合并 main（T5 #13）后的 `e72dc5d` 上重跑：420 passed，test_diff 无新失败，lint 通过。
4:- 环境：macOS，uv，Python 3.12.8。**无新增依赖**；`httpx` 从 dev 依赖移到运行依赖（agent 运行时用它调 LLM），`uv.lock` 同步。
5:- 范围：`backend/app/agent/**`、`backend/tests/test_agent_*.py`、`backend/tests/agent_helpers.py`、本目录；
6:  另改 `backend/pyproject.toml` / `uv.lock`（仅 httpx 那一行）。没有改 airline / store / core / 契约 / `main.py`。
7:
8:## 1. 做了什么（`backend/app/agent/`）
9:
10:| 文件 | 内容 |
11:|---|---|
12:| `config.py` | `LLMConfig.from_env()`：`LLM_API_KEY`（回退 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）、`LLM_BASE_URL`（默认 `https://api.deepseek.com`）、`LLM_MODEL`（默认 `deepseek-flash`）、`LLM_REASONING_EFFORT`（默认 `high`）。先读进程环境，再读 `OCEAN_ENV_FILE` 指向的 `.env`（默认仓库根 `.env`）。key 不进 repr、不进日志。 |
13:| `llm.py` | `OpenAIChatClient`：纯 httpx 的 OpenAI 兼容流式 client。`stream(messages, tools, reasoning_effort=None)` 逐段给 `TextDelta`，最后给一个 `Completion`（分片的 tool call 参数拼完整、usage、reasoning）。所有失败都是 `LLMError(retryable)`；错误信息里的 key 被抹掉，401/403 不引用响应体。 |
14:| `tools.py` | 4 个工具的 schema（参数只有名字和 id，全是字符串，`additionalProperties:false`）、手写参数校验、`Toolbox.run` 分发。失败（未知工具 / 参数不合法 / 工具抛异常）都是给 LLM 的结构化记录，不抛出。 |
15:| `guard.py` | `CityIndex`（在文本里找库内城市名）、`ReplyGuard`（数字 / 日期时间 / id / 城市按值溯源）、`SentenceBuffer`（流式按句切分）。 |
16:| `templates.py` | `fallback_reply(outcomes)`：只用本轮工具结果拼出的模板回复。 |
17:| `context.py` | `build_context`：从 app.db 重建 LLM 上下文（消息 + 历史工具调用 + 出票事件 + reasoning 回传），超预算时压缩最早的轮次。 |
18:| `prompt.py` | system prompt（v3，见 §4）。不含城市列表。 |
19:| `loop.py` | `Agent.stream_turn(user_id, conversation_id, text, *, reasoning_effort=None)`：一轮对话 → 契约 SSE 事件。 |
20:| `sse.py` | `encode(event)` / `encode_stream(events)`：`event: …\ndata: …\n\n`。 |
21:
22:### 一轮对话
23:1. `stream_turn` **同步**检查：文本非空且 ≤ 2000 字符、`reasoning_effort` 合法、会话属于该用户（否则 `ValueError` / `NotFound`，
24:   此时什么都没落库）。然后起一个独立 task 跑这一轮，返回事件的异步迭代器。**客户端断开后这一轮照常跑完并落库。**
25:2. task 拿会话锁（`airline.locks.hold_async`，与出票接口同一把）→ 存 user 消息 → `user_message` 事件 → 会话无标题时用首条消息前 60 字符做标题。
26:3. 最多 `MAX_STEPS = 6` 步：调 LLM；有 tool call 就逐个 `status` → 执行 → `tool_calls` 落库 → 每张卡 `card` 事件 → 结果回给 LLM；
27:   没有 tool call 就是最终文本。
28:4. 文本按句放行：每放行一句前，用 ReplyGuard 检查「**到目前为止的全文 + 这一句**」（能抓到跨句的 `St. | Louis`、被切开的数字）。
29:   通过 → `delta`；不通过 → `replace`（模板）并结束。空白不单独发送。
30:5. 结束：`airline.post_assistant_message(...)`（quote 卡此刻 `presented` 并拿到 nonce）→ `done`。
31:6. 每 15 s 没有事件就发 `ping`。
32:
33:| 情况 | 结果 |
34:|---|---|
35:| 某句没通过 guard | `replace` 模板 + `done`；`messages.guard_problems = [{"kind": "number"/"city"/"date"/"time"/"id", "value"}]`；被拒原文存在 `llm_calls.response`（`aborted: true`） |
36:| LLM 返回空文本 | 模板 + `done`，`guard_problems = [{"kind":"empty_reply"}]` |
37:| 到 `MAX_STEPS` 仍在调工具 | 模板 + `done`，`[{"kind":"max_steps"}]` |
38:| LLM 超时 / 5xx / 429 / 断流 | 指数退避重试 2 次（0.5 s、1 s）；**本次调用已有文本放行后不重试**（否则会重复已显示的内容） |

returned; it never computes a route or a price and it has no way to book."""

"""Wire form of the events: `event: <name>\\ndata: <json>\\n\\n` (docs/api/contract.md)."""

import json
from typing import AsyncIterator

from .loop import Event

MEDIA_TYPE = "text/event-stream"
# no proxy buffering, no caching: each event must reach the browser when it is written
HEADERS = {"Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"}


def encode(event: Event) -> str:
    data = json.dumps(event.data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))

        yield encode(event)

"""Scaffolding for the agent tests: a scripted fake LLM and helpers to run a turn and to check
the event stream against the contract."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.agent import Agent, Completion, Event, TextDelta

from .airline_helpers import assert_card, assert_message


class Call:
    """A tool call in a script. `raw` replaces the JSON arguments (to send broken ones)."""

    def __init__(self, tool: str, /, raw: str | None = None, **args: Any):
        self.name = tool
        self.arguments = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(args)


class Think:
    """Reasoning text of a step (thinking mode): stored with the call, never a TextDelta."""

    def __init__(self, text: str):
        self.text = text


class Wait:
    """Pause the scripted stream: `await gate.wait()` (asyncio.Event) or sleep `seconds`."""

    def __init__(self, gate: asyncio.Event | None = None, seconds: float = 0.0):
        self.gate, self.seconds = gate, seconds




def tool_results(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """The decoded tool results in a context, oldest first."""
    return [json.loads(m["content"]) for m in messages if m["role"] == "tool"]


def last_quote_id(messages: list[dict]) -> str:
    return [r["quote_id"] for r in tool_results(messages) if "quote_id" in r][-1]


def run_turn(agent: Agent, user: str, conv: str, text: str) -> list[Event]:
    async def go():
        events = [e async for e in agent.stream_turn(user, conv, text)]
        await agent.wait_idle()
        return events

    return asyncio.run(go())


def names(events: list[Event]) -> list[str]:
    return [e.name for e in events]


def final_text(events: list[Event]) -> str:
    """What the client shows at the end, built the way a client builds it: deltas appended,
    `replace` replacing everything so far."""
    text = ""
    for e in events:
        if e.name == "delta":
            text += e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "replace":
            text = e.data["text"]
    return text


def assert_stream(events: list[Event], schemas: dict | None = None) -> dict | None:
    """The stream follows docs/api/contract.md. Returns the `done` message (None for `error`)."""
    kinds = names(events)
    assert kinds[0] == "user_message", kinds
    assert kinds.count("user_message") == 1
    assert kinds[-1] in ("done", "error") and sum(k in ("done", "error") for k in kinds) == 1, kinds
    assert set(kinds) <= {"user_message", "status", "card", "delta", "replace", "ping", "done", "error"}
    assert_message(events[0].data, schemas)
    assert events[0].data["role"] == "user" and events[0].data["cards"] == []
    pushed = []
    for e in events[1:-1]:
        if e.name == "status":
            assert set(e.data) == {"text"} and e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "card":
            assert set(e.data) == {"card"}
            assert_card(e.data["card"], schemas)
            state = e.data["card"].get("state")
            assert state is None or (state["bookable"] is False and state["nonce"] is None)
            pushed.append(e.data["card"])
        elif e.name in ("delta", "replace"):
            assert set(e.data) == {"text"} and isinstance(e.data["text"], str) and e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "ping":
            assert e.data == {}
    last = events[-1]
    if last.name == "error":
        assert set(last.data) == {"code", "message"}
        return None
    assert set(last.data) == {"message"}
    message = last.data["message"]
    assert_message(message, schemas)
    assert message["role"] == "assistant"
    assert final_text(events).rstrip() == message["text"]
    # the final message has exactly the cards that were pushed, in order
    assert [(c["type"], c.get("id")) for c in message["cards"]] == [(c["type"], c.get("id")) for c in pushed]
    return message
